clue.text: A person compelled to serve in a private capacity

definitions.text: A person compelled to serve in a private capacity

parts.words: A person compelled to serve in a private capacity
parts.note: reads like someone forced to work discreetly for a household, but 'private' is the lowest army rank and the person was called up by law

explanation.surface: Someone obliged to work quietly behind the scenes for a private employer.
explanation.definitionFit: A draftee is someone required by law to join the armed forces, typically entering as a private soldier.

clue.text: Start public collection

parts.note: news that is out has become public
a set is a collection of matching items

explanation.surface: The opening of a collection that is open to the public.
explanation.definitionFit: The beginning of an undertaking is its very first moment; synonyms.

clue.text: Ironic humour at being received by father

indicators.note: the small word is taken in and held inside the word for father

parts.note: a sire is a father, especially of an animal
taken as written

explanation.surface: Dad greets something with a dry, ironic joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Mockery that uses irony and ridicule to expose folly is the literary form of satirical writing.

clue.text: He works constructively — a topping man!

definitions.text: He works constructively — a topping man!

parts.words: He works constructively — a topping man!
parts.note: 'topping' sounds like old slang for excellent, but this builder works on the top of a house, covering it with tiles or slates

explanation.surface: Praise for a splendid fellow who builds things.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who lays tiles or slates on houses works on the highest covering of a building.

clue.text: Shave beforehand and get ready

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before
to pare is to shave or trim off a thin layer

explanation.surface: A man has a shave before getting ready to go out.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue gives the trim first and the timing second, but the pieces go in the other order: PRE before PARE.
explanation.definitionFit: To make something ready in advance is to arrange or set it up; synonyms.

clue.text: Given a key, made a mess but looked radiant

parts.note: G is a musical key
to litter is to make a mess by scattering rubbish

explanation.surface: Someone handed a key made a mess, yet still beamed with delight.
explanation.definitionFit: To sparkle or shine brightly is to give off flashes of light; synonyms.

clue.text: Where anybody interested can watch the stars come out

definitions.text: Where anybody interested can watch the stars come out

parts.words: Where anybody interested can watch the stars come out
parts.note: sounds like stargazing at nightfall, but the stars are actors leaving a theatre by the performers' rear exit

explanation.surface: A spot for skywatchers to see the night sky light up.
explanation.definitionFit: The rear entrance of a theatre used by performers is where fans wait for autographs.

clue.text: Sees grant is arranged for translation of volume

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A translator obtains a grant to render a book into another language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' looks like a book being translated, but it means bulk or size. 'for translation of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Great size or bulk is the sense in which volume means largeness; synonyms.

clue.text: Protective clothing from Northern Ireland

definitions.meaning: a long loose belted overcoat, originally made in Belfast
the historic province that broadly covers the six counties of Northern Ireland

explanation.definitionFit: The heavy overcoat is named after the Irish province that largely makes up the UK's Northern Ireland.

clue.text: Place the monarch found for a paper-seller

parts.note: a station is a place or post where someone stands
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: The Queen discovers a spot for a newsagent.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop selling writing paper, envelopes and pens is run by a stationery dealer.

clue.text: Greek character without tin-opener-shame!

indicators.note: used in its old sense of outside, so the Greek letter goes around the other piece

parts.note: sigma is the Greek letter S

indicators.note: the opener of tin is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Greek man ashamed at having no tin-opener.
explanation.definitionFit: A mark of disgrace or dishonour attached to someone is the social stain of a stigma.

clue.text: Soldiers prevail in revolt, causing a suspension

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: letters in revolt overturn their order and rearrange

explanation.surface: Troops win an uprising, leading to a halt in hostilities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in revolt' turns PREVAIL into PRIEVAL, placed after RE. 'causing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A temporary halt to a sentence, especially execution, is the delay granted by a reprieve.

clue.text: Forward boy pocketing a tip

indicators.note: one piece pockets the other, holding it inside

parts.note: a son is a boy
an end is a tip

explanation.surface: A forward-thinking lad slips a gratuity into his pocket.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass a letter on to a new address is to redirect or forward it.

clue.text: An inordinate fondness for sales-pitch rhetoric

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement, a sales pitch
an oration is a piece of formal rhetoric

explanation.surface: Someone excessively fond of salesmen's patter.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep love and worship is an extreme form of affection; synonyms.

clue.text: Confirm when definite

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as she left'
certain means definite

explanation.surface: Make sure of something once it is settled.
explanation.definitionFit: To find out for sure is to establish or verify a fact; synonyms.

clue.text: Occasionally moulds seem moist

indicators.note: to mould is to reshape, so the letters are reformed

explanation.surface: Damp patches of fungus now and then look wet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moulds' reads as a fungus noun, but it is a verb reshaping SEEM MOIST.
explanation.definitionFit: Now and then, at irregular intervals; synonyms.

clue.text: Set-back for a supporter

indicators.note: set back means the word is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: to gel is to set, like jelly

explanation.surface: A setback for someone who backs a cause.
explanation.definitionFit: A limb that holds up a body or a table is one of its props.

clue.text: Pasture for some little animals

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the phrase are taken, a run inside it

explanation.surface: Grazing land for a few small creatures.
explanation.definitionFit: A meadow or grassy field is a poetic word for grazing land.

clue.text: Chat idly or hang up

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Chat idly or hang up' for GAS: 'Chat idly' gives GAS but no sense of 'hang up' gives it; likely an OCR misread with no scan to check, and a search found nothing.

clue.text: The underworld strip, given direction to strip

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and his realm
to rob is to strip someone of possessions
E is east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: Stripping off in the land of the dead, following instructions.
explanation.definitionFit: To take one's clothes off is to undress; synonyms.

clue.text: One's holding out, turning sour

indicators.note: the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards, plus the S of the 's

indicators.note: the little word turns about and changes its letter order

explanation.surface: A person holding out against something becomes sour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes TOU from OUT, held inside ACES.
explanation.definitionFit: Like vinegar, acidic and tart in taste; a technical word for sourness.

clue.text: Using a certain craft to get dope

parts.note: SS is a steamship, a particular kind of vessel

explanation.surface: Someone uses a special skill to obtain drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A dope is a fool or idiot; donkey-based synonym for a dunce.

clue.text: View a piece of paper as evidence of a leak

parts.note: to see is to view
a page is a sheet of paper

explanation.surface: Reading a document that proves secrets were leaked.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid slowly oozing through gives the telltale sign that a pipe or vessel is not watertight.

clue.text: Cut expenses, not for the first time, but still smoked

parts.note: re- means again, so not for the first time
eked out, made money stretch by economising

explanation.surface: A smoker trimmed spending again yet still lit up.
explanation.definitionFit: Gave off smoke or fumes; an older sense of emitting vapour.

clue.text: Note landed gentleman appears elated

parts.note: B is a musical note
lit, as a bird alights or lands
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A note says a landed gent seems happy.
explanation.definitionFit: Carefree and cheerful; synonyms.

clue.text: A rest's essential for such plants

indicators.note: the letters are the essence or raw material of the answer, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Gardeners say some flowers need a dormant period.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essential' is a loose anagram signal: the letters of A REST'S are all the answer is made of.
explanation.definitionFit: Michaelmas daisies are daisy-like flowering garden perennials of this genus.

clue.text: Sanctimonious old tyrant — a playwright

parts.note: pi is short for pious, sanctimonious
Nero was a tyrannical Roman emperor

explanation.surface: A self-righteous ancient despot turned dramatist.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Arthur Wing Pinero was an English dramatist of the late Victorian era.

clue.text: Quite practical reform, it is clear

indicators.note: to reform is to shape again, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A political reform is plainly sensible.
explanation.definitionFit: Sensible and down-to-earth, dealing with things as they are; synonyms.

clue.text: A little bird with a little tasty morsel

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
a bit is a little

explanation.surface: A small bird pecks at a tasty mouthful.
explanation.definitionFit: A choice small piece of food is a tidbit.

clue.text: American stock holders

parts.note: sounds like shareholders on Wall Street, but the stock is livestock tended on ranches

explanation.surface: Investors holding shares in US companies.
explanation.definitionFit: Ranchers and cowboys who raise or tend livestock in the US.

clue.text: The guy who's evil or bent

indicators.note: bent means twisted out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man who is wicked or crooked.
explanation.definitionFit: A boy's given name, so a guy, such as Dickens's orphan Twist.

clue.text: Touching submission indicating a slowdown

parts.note: re means regarding or touching on
a cession is a yielding or surrender

explanation.surface: A moving act of surrender signals economic decline.
explanation.definitionFit: A period of falling economic activity is a downturn; synonyms.
